links.outcome: Model sensitivity across 12 independent external cohorts (multiple sites)
links.effect: External validation (Stage II) sensitivity reached 0.902 and improved to 0.968 with proposed strategies; biopsy ROC-AUC 0.990 (95% CI 0.984-0.997).
links.quote: In external validation (Stage II), the sensitivity reached 0.902 and improved to 0.968 with proposed strategies.

links.outcome: Performance on external multisite and temporally later data versus internal validation
links.effect: Internal accuracy 0.980 and ROC-AUC 0.995; external sensitivity 0.902 (0.968 with strategies); real-world Stage III balanced accuracy 0.953 with 100% sensitivity (45/45).
links.quote: In large-scale real-world deployment (Stage III, n = 7,056), GASPath achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.953, with 100% sensitivity for GAS (45/45 cases correctly identified).

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI histopathological diagnostic system (GASPath) for endocervical gastric-type adenocarcinoma, including validation across retrospective cohorts and a large-scale real-world deployment on over 7,000 samples, but does not compare specific deployment practices or safeguards.
